items.title: AI發展與普及速度受制於安全性不足，SailPoint創辦人呼籲整個產業持續投入並付諸行動
items.summary: 近期頂尖AI模型服務失控事件引發關注，日前造訪香港的SailPoint執行長暨創辦人Mark McClain表示，AI不會也不該停下發展的腳步，關鍵在於設法提升AI安全性。他也談到該公司提倡的適應性身分，這是為了因應動態環境即時處理需求而發展的身分防護機制。最後，為了讓大家理解AI與安全性之間的關係，他特別用F1賽車為喻，指出煞車是否完善，是影響跑車能否發揮速度的關鍵，AI也是如此。

items.title: test(channels): initialize Telegram binding contract runtime
items.summary: test(channels): initialize Telegram binding contract runtime The registry-backed fixture registers Telegram's channel directly and omitted the runtime initialization performed by the production loader. Since #175379 captures that runtime when creating the binding manager, the contract failed with "Telegram runtime not initialized". Initialize the fixture through Telegram's narrow runtime setter and back its state API with the existing isolated plugin-state test store. Preserve all capability, bind, unbind and cleanup assertions. Production startup, reload, cross-plugin runtime ownership and Telegram transport are unchanged. Current-main baseline reproduced the reported failure, with four other channel cases passing. The repaired contract passes all five cases under pinned Bun. Owning core/plugin-SDK test types, scoped lint, formatting and independent P2 autoreview pass. No live Telegram behavior is claimed.
